title: EU Digital Markets Act Compliance
description: Regulations requiring interoperability and data portability for major tech platforms.
full_text: The Digital Markets Act (DMA) establishes rules for designated gatekeepers to ensure contestability and fairness in digital markets. Gatekeepers must comply with obligations regarding data sharing, interoperability, and fair access.
summary: Requires major platforms to ensure data portability, interoperability, and fair access for competitors.

changes.description: Added clarification on messaging interoperability requirements
